age_limit.details: Please refer to the official notification for age limit details.

qualification.details: Project Associate: M.Sc. degree in Biotechnology or Botany with consistently good academic record, preferably >75% or equivalent CGPA. Prior research experience of at least six months in Biotechnology, advanced molecular biology or Life Sciences. Expertise in scientific writing skills will be given added consideration. Only Indian nationals can apply.

salary_details.details: Project Associate: Rs. 37,000/- per month + HRA (NET/GATE) or Rs. 30,000/- per month + HRA

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for ICGEB Project Associate Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 17-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Associate: M.Sc. degree in Biotechnology or Botany with consistently good academic record, preferably >75% or equivalent CGPA. Prior research experience of at least six months in Biotechnology, advanced molecular biology or Life Sciences. Expertise in scientific writing skills will be given added consideration. Only Indian nationals can apply.

content_sections.text: Project Associate: Rs. 37,000/- per month + HRA (NET/GATE) or Rs. 30,000/- per month + HRA

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ICGEB Project Associate Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 17-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.answer: The recruitment is for the International Centre for Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology (ICGEB).

faq.answer: The post available is Project Associate.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there for Project Associate?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the Project Associate post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for ICGEB Project Associate?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the Project Associate post is 17 August 2026.

faq.answer: Candidates need to apply by sending their application via Email.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required qualification for Project Associate?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an M.Sc. degree in Biotechnology or Botany with a good academic record.

faq.answer: The salary for Project Associate is Rs. 37,000/- per month + HRA (NET/GATE) or Rs. 30,000/- per month + HRA.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for ICGEB Project Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST).

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for Project Associate?
faq.answer: The selection process for Project Associate involves an Interview, which can be conducted both online and offline.
